title: Data Analytics
description: A beginner course for school leavers who want to turn numbers into decisions. You will clean data, analyse it in a spreadsheet, calculate simple statistics, build clear charts, and take your first steps in SQL and Python for data.
outcomes: Explain what a data analyst does and the main types of data
Clean messy data and organise it into a tidy table
Use SUM, AVERAGE, COUNTIF, sorting, filtering and pivot tables in a spreadsheet
Calculate and interpret mean, median, mode and range
Choose the right chart and present a short data story
Write basic SQL queries and simple Python code to answer business questions
